guarantees.claim: hw2reg.err_code.d is assigned the concatenated {code, info} of the highest priority error source with valid=1 (priority order: app_err > errchecker_err > sha3_err > entropy_err > msgfifo_err), or 0 if no error is valid.

assumptions.claim: Each incoming error struct (app_err, errchecker_err, sha3_err, entropy_err, msgfifo_err) provides valid, code, and info fields with correct widths, and drives them consistently when valid is asserted.
assumptions.cond: when an error source captures an error
assumptions.risk: Incorrect or malformed {code, info} may be latched into the error register, leading to wrong error reporting or exposure of raw internal state through info.

uncertain_points.claim: If the hw2reg.err_code register updates every clock cycle (continuous latching of d), a higher-priority error may be overwritten by a later lower-priority error before software can read it.
uncertain_points.cond: Multiple errors occur in quick succession and the register is not protected by a sticky mechanism or gated until software clears.
uncertain_points.risk: Critical error information (e.g., app_err, security violation) could be silently lost, causing missing alert handling and potential security bypass.
